scope: Three new runtime/storage/schema files only. Actual extracted function models and source trace; no native SQL, installed application, provider network or email delivery acceptance.

validation.schema_physical_model: The actual schema declaration is checked, but database schema introspection is modeled; no MySQL engine claim.
validation.network: Read and send callbacks are modeled; actual typed template document/writer and ProviderGateway request fingerprint execute.
validation.minimal: Windows -n with explicit installed OpenSSL extension directory. PDO/tokenizer are built into this installed PHP; no general plain -n portability claim.

resolved_review_findings: Bounded keyset chunks of 32 verify ciphertext hashes and discard ciphertext from retained graph; explicit private open rereads and revalidates one row.
Physical COUNT equals authenticated count before keyset traversal, so an extra seq=0 row cannot be skipped unnoticed.
Shared operation fingerprint is the dedicated profile ID:revision:SHA256(encrypted credential blob) identity, identical in runtime and native fixture.
Preparation only reads the original existing provider vault key; absence refuses rather than creating a replacement.
Historical request validation recomputes exact review HMAC and original freshness relationship; orphan operation keys require exact prefix and ID.
Private ciphertext/open corruption is not swallowed as a stale editor context.

native_source_review.reviewed: Five-argument read and six-argument send, original cipher identity, real cooldown sequencing, thirteen GET/three POST expected path, admission/terminal/check audit fault rollback, claimed/missing/reconciled ledger refusals, current-owner/key changes and exact restoration.
native_source_review.limit: Source-only review. Linux guard, SQL setup, concurrency and provider transport still require actual native execution.

initial_harness_failure: The first -n invocation could not locate Windows OpenSSL because extension_dir defaulted to C:/php/ext. Original output retained; final-02 supplies actual installed extension directory. Initial duplicate-extension warning is also retained.
remaining: Installed HTTP/browser callback and actual provider response handling in acceptance
